in_marathi.long_meaning: Geetansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Geetansh is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Geeta' meaning song and 'Ansh' meaning form or manifestation. The name symbolizes the divine song or mantra that connects us to the Gods.
